header_sub: Richer shapes + host view. Drag any box to move it, drag the background to pan, scroll / pinch buttons to zoom, click a box for its details. Dragging explores the view — it does not change the canonical source (docs/architecture.md in this repo). Demo only: Emma / Noah.
panel_body: Every container from the approved v2 is here, re-drawn by type and placed on its real host. The Card Page is a screen, the Gate is a server, the Generator / Minter / watches are workers, the JSON files are cylinders, and Google's two services are clouds. Click any box for its job.
footer_note: This page is the interactive rendering of the canonical v3 diagram in docs/architecture.md (same folder) — the Mermaid source there is the source of truth, and this rendering is generated from the same model. The demo's note flow is the designed full flow; in the demo repo the note box is disabled and the endpoint is a stub.

cloudflare.title: Cloudflare Pages
cloudflare.sub: Edge hosting — the gated site lives here

kid.title: Emma / Noah
kid.body: Each kid reads only their own card, and can send a note from it. Access is by a coded link, not an account.

owner.title: Dad
owner.body: Reads both cards with tabs. Mints the access codes (via the Minter) and receives new-note alerts.

parent.title: Parent viewer
parent.body: Reads both cards, logistics only, with a parent-scoped code.

repo.title: Family Cards Demo Repo
repo.body: Canonical source: page, gate, generator, and the architecture diagram — plus the generated card data the workers push.

page.title: Card Page
page.body: The only thing a reader ever sees. Renders one kid card, or both with tabs for owner / parent. Shows Big and CHANGED tags and the notes box. It never calls a calendar API.

gate.title: Gate Middleware
gate.body: Checks every request: redeems a code against stored hashes, sets a signed scoped cookie, enforces scope per file, answers the scope check, and handles the note endpoint. Fails closed.

carddata.title: Per-kid Card Data
carddata.body: emma.json and noah.json — one file per kid: two-week window, With Dad / With Mom days, entries, legs, CHANGED tags, and that kid's own notes only.

codes.title: Access Code Hashes
codes.body: codes.json holds SHA-256 hashes and expiries only. Plain codes are never stored anywhere in the system.

gen.title: Card Generator
gen.body: The engine. Reads the calendars, drops sensitive and admin events, frames With Dad / With Mom, resolves drivers, applies Big and CHANGED, folds in kid notes, and writes the per-kid JSON.

minter.title: Code Minter
minter.body: Mints random per-scope expiring codes in batches. Only the hashes are committed to the repo.

watch.title: Notes Watch + Rebuilds
watch.body: Morning and nightly rebuilds, rebuilds when a change is spotted, and the notes watch: poll the form, alert Dad verbatim on a new note, then regenerate.

snap.title: Snapshots + Notes State
snap.body: The previous card per kid (the CHANGED diff baseline and the Last changed stamp) and the seen-note IDs used to dedupe form responses.

cal.title: Google Calendar
cal.body: The source calendars (generic labels: Primary, Family, Kids). Read only on the assistant side — no calendar credential ever lives on the web host.

form.title: Google Form
form.body: The kid-notes inbox in the full flow: notes land as form responses, never linked publicly. In the demo this is stubbed — the box is disabled and nothing is forwarded.
